The decision that outranks the other two
Stack A files a claim as (investigation, claim, version) with a JSON body; stack C files it as a content-addressed
node id. That key decides both the identity seam and the journal seam: make the node key canonical and A's
before/after history has to be re-referenced or lost; keep the blob key and typed edges never land. The recompute
seam forces a separate owner choice, and waiting on it costs copy, not a migration.
